title: Subhe ashoor
body:
Subhe ashoor
<<MINI>>
Subhe ashoor, subhe ashoor ali akber (teri azan) x3
Subhe ashoor ali akber (teri azan) x3
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaleja thaam ke khayme me (royi maa) x2 Teri azan
<<MINI>>
Subhe ashoor ali akber (teri azan) x3
<<DIVIDER>>
(Salaam lehjaye rasool ki shabahat, Salaam marzie mabood per shahadat) x3 Shahadato ki zami per thi aasma, thi aasma teri azan
<<MINI>>
Subhe ashoor ali akber (teri azan) x3
<<DIVIDER>>
(Who tum jo ashado an laillaha bole, dhariche kudsiyo ne khole) x3 Khuda ke zikr se saji huwi zabaan, saji huwi zabaan, teri azan
<<MINI>>
Subhe ashoor ali akber (teri azan) x3
<<DIVIDER>>
(Hussain jisko sun ke roye, parinde shaak per na soye) x3 Sadaay-e-gham suni gayi kaha kaha, kaha kaha teri azan
<<MINI>>
Subhe ashoor ali akber (teri azan) x3
<<DIVIDER>>
(Who khayma gah tak jo ayi, Teri azan-e-karbalayi) x3 Jigar ko tham ke yeh keh rahi thi maa, rahi thi maa teri azan
<<MINI>>
Subhe ashoor ali akber (teri azan) x3
<<DIVIDER>>
(Hawa ke dosh per watan tak, azan pohonch gayi behen tak) x3 Behan tarap ne lagi le ke hichkiya, hichkiya teri azan
<<MINI>>
Subhe ashoor ali akber (teri azan) x3
<<DIVIDER>>
(Sina jigar pe tumne khayi, azan ki aabru bachaayi) x3 Rahe na tum magar bachi rahi azan, rahi azan, teri azan
<<MINI>>
Subhe ashoor ali akber (teri azan) x3
